original_semantics: GlobalManagerStatsImpl has four additive in-memory data/protocol sent/received counters. LAN traffic contributes to ordinary totals/rates; NoLAN averages exclude it. Its four ordinary Average instances use1000ms buckets and10s windows.

Original Average timestamps additions with stepped monotonic time; getAverage sums completed slots, excludes current incomplete slot and divides by period. A native interval average over session snapshots is a different explicit policy, not exact original ten-second smoothing.

TransferStatsView Now sums global data+protocol receive/send rates and shows protocol shares. Session uses four global-manager cumulative counters. Activity samples those global values plus limits/swarm series roughly once per second.

GeneralStats/OverallStats lifetime and marks use independently saved BiglyBT.statistics totals and wallclock-based uptime. Session uptime belongs to OverallStats instance lifetime, not one native transfer. New operation counters must not alter saved lifetime/marks or silently claim application-wide persistent/session parity.

engine_metric_contract.source_arithmetic: session_impl::received_bytes/sent_bytes increments combined by bytes_payload+bytes_protocol, and payload by bytes_payload. For each direction protocol = checked(combined-payload).
engine_metric_contract.separate_domains: IP overhead, tracker bytes and DHT bytes have separately updated counters. Do not mix them into the four chosen peer-transfer counters or add payload to already combined totals.
engine_metric_contract.mapping: session_stats_metrics returns names/value_index/type; require four distinct in-range indices of metric_type_t::counter, never hardcode enum numeric positions. Mapping is version-bound and stable for one loaded library.
engine_metric_contract.request: post_session_stats asynchronously posts an explicit session_stats_alert; it is not filtered by alert_mask and needs no new global logging/category enablement.
engine_metric_contract.ownership: Copy the four primitive values during the existing pop_alerts batch. Alerts and counters() span are borrowed session storage, invalid after subsequent pop calls; never queue raw spans/alert pointers to GUI or keep a second alert consumer.
engine_metric_contract.lifetime: Session counters initialize at zero for a new LT session and accumulate across its torrents. Current continueLocal/continueMultifile construct and destroy one session per operation. Torrent status counters reset on resume/pause boundaries and are unsuitable substitutes.
engine_metric_contract.clock: alert::timestamp uses clock_type=std::chrono::high_resolution_clock. Installed GCC16 chrono.h explicitly aliases it to system_clock. Use native steady_clock observation time for intervals; do not treat this LT timestamp as monotonic.
engine_metric_contract.overflow: LT counter source asserts nonnegative/monotone under normal increments, not an application saturation protocol. Validate each observed int64 and total>=payload; treat regressions, negative values, invalid mapping/span and dropped/unobserved samples explicitly rather than unsigned wrapping.

recommended_one_milestone.name: P04-16 real owned-engine operation session telemetry
recommended_one_milestone.observable_scope: This owned engine session / operation only, with data+protocol, payload and checked protocol counters/rates. Retain original unavailable application-session/global-history labels outside that exact domain.
recommended_one_milestone.pure_accumulator: Four raw nonnegative totals, strictly increasing explicit steady observation time, independent operation reset. First valid observation gives known totals/elapsed0 and unavailable rates; later valid observations give exact checked interval rates. Invalid samples reject without mutation. All four raw and both derived protocol totals must be monotone.
recommended_one_milestone.rate_math: floor(delta*1000000000/dtNanoseconds) for six rates with overflow-safe exact arithmetic. If an admitted total interval yields any rate above INT64_MAX, preserve accepted totals/time but rates unavailable; never UB, clamp or replace them withzero. Rate derived fields can differ by1 because independent floors.
recommended_one_milestone.engine_integration: One stats sampler inside each actual LT session scope; at most one outstanding request, bounded steady cadence through existing shared wait/pop loop. Integrate both single-file and multifile paths; preserve existing fixed deadlines/error processing/flush and completion ordering. Telemetry loss or malformed stats must not invent storage success or silently extend a transfer timeout.
recommended_one_milestone.identity: Separate nonzero owned-operation identity plus profile session and immutable original target. Do not rely only on torrent hash/library revision: a later same-target operation is a new engine session. Old queued observations cannot overwrite a newer operation or replacement page.
recommended_one_milestone.end_semantics: Label ended/cancelled/failed and last-observed sample explicitly. After owner teardown there is no newrate sample; no artificial zero. A last pre-teardown observation is not guaranteed to include every shutdown byte. No callback from an LT-affine destructor; publish operation lifecycle from controller/worker completion after actual owner scope returns.
recommended_one_milestone.existing_values: Keep old payload progress callback behavior and saved per-download counter updates unchanged. Never write BiglyBT.statistics, seed operation totals from saved globals or add operation totals across fresh owners as lifetime/application-session totals.
recommended_one_milestone.UI: Add an explicitly identified owned-engine operation section to Transfers/Activity, actual observed intervals and bounded plots. No regular sampler/timer while idle; snapshots are received from active owned engine work and remain owned after close. Root chooses precise display/pipeline API.
not_in_scope: Summing concurrent/future sessions as original global state
Protocol byte-exact equality across network timing
Persistent history or additional backend networking

qualification_plan: Pure generated accumulator cases: unknown first-rate, exact counters/protocol, strict times, zero delta over positive time, equal/backward time rejection without mutation, raw/protocol regressions, negative/total<payload, floor-rounding relations, INT64 extremes and independent rational reference vectors.

Actual generated loopback single/multifile owned transfers: nonzero payload/combined/known protocol observations, source-bound named metric mapping, valid ownership after later alert pops and owner teardown, existing flush/completion/profile byte protections unchanged. Do not assert fixed handshake/protocol byte amounts.
Lifecycle/cancellation/error/repeated-same-hash/page-close/reopen/late packet tests. Unavailable or closed telemetry must never become saved lifetime totals or change library selection/counters.

Strict GCC16/Clang24 and leak-enabled ASan/UBSan, existing lower regressions/actual local transfer and Statistics smoke/hosted CI; root owns execution. No original Java runtime equality or performance credit from this audit.
